answer: This system uses insurance staking, where each identity locks 50 units forfeited if its holder is caught running clones; activation counts only after the holder carries one opal weighing 10 grams across a 30-meter garden path, places it at the vertex where two measured lines meet, and leaves it there for 60 seconds while a sensor records its weight every 5 seconds; a weight off by more than 0.1 grams, a crossing under 20 seconds, or a missing reading voids activation, so 100 fakes need 100 separate stakes, opals, and crossings.
